title: Mobility Carsharing
description: Swiss carsharing for the Teneo voice demo: voice authentication (name, driving licence, one-time code), extending a booking with a conflict, EV charge check for a trip and switching to another car. Swiss customers, prices in CHF.
notes:
Brand-neutral data, fictional phone numbers (+41 79 555 ...) and example.com emails. Booking times are local Zurich times (HH:mm) on the day in 'date'; dates are relative to the day the config is loaded, so reset it before a demo. The Teneo solution uses a demo clock (global demoClock, default 16:40) so the times in the script always fit.

Test customers:
- Anna Meier (C001, licence CH-ZH-8847261, mobile ending 89, one-time code 482913): the demo script. Active booking BK-118001 on the VW ID.3 (V101) until 18:00 at 38% charge; Thomas Keller has the same car from 19:30, so the latest return is 19:15. Luzern and back (104 km) would leave about 9% (below the 20% return rule). The VW ID.4 (V205) at Loewenplatz, about 4 minutes on foot, has 86% and is free all evening. Flex plan, about 10 hours a month in comfort EVs, so Flex Plus would save about CHF 15 a month. Card on file: Visa ending 1234.
- Luca Bernasconi (C002, licence CH-TI-5521093, code 615204): Flex Plus, active booking BK-118004 on the Renault Zoe until 17:30, nobody after him, so a short trip is a simple extension.
- Sophie Dubois (C003, licence CH-GE-3307815): verification locked after 3 failed attempts today, so the bot hands over to a human.
- Thomas Keller (C004, licence CH-ZH-6120448, code 204877): owns the conflicting booking BK-118002 and tomorrow's ID.4 booking.

Catalogue: plans (OCCASIONAL, FLEX, FLEX_PLUS with hourly rates per vehicle class), stations with coordinates, destinations with distances from Zurich and the fast charger there, rules R-EV (minimum return charge), R-BOOKING (turnaround, walking speed) and R-DISCOUNT. The flows write otp_codes, messages and new bookings.
